enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Healers Bounty: This shield has a small percentage chance to cast a Heal spell on you when you take damage.
Sonic Guard: This item blasts those that attack the wearer, causing 1d6 sonic damage on a successful melee attack.
Mithral: Mithral armor is one type lighter then normal. Arcane Spell Failure decreased by 10%. Maximum dexterity bonus increased by 2. Armor check penalty reduced by 3.

Levik's Defender: With 2 items equipped - +3 Insight bonus to AC, 20% Additional Melee Threat, Unlisted Fortitude and Will Save +1 (Stacks with most but not Parrying/Greater Parrying). With 3 items equipped - +5 insight AC, 30% Additional Melee Threat (Threat stacks, but only with non-like amounts)
